title: Patch notes, voting and Chime
body:
• New /patch-notes command — run it to see what has changed
• New /vote command listing every site you can vote on
• Voting on Top.gg and Chime now pays 10 Crowns each, once per day
• The Studio now shows every server the bot is actually in
• Fixed the Crowns and Billing page crashing on the Studio

title: Colour roles and saved aesthetics
body:
• /color lets members pick from the colour roles you make on the dashboard
• The dashboard can create cosmetic colour roles
• /saved no longer prints a colour swatch line under each aesthetic
